units: cm; UE axes: +X forward, +Y right (left = -Y), +Z up
notes: Hero parts rotate rigidly around their pivots; every socket has zero rotation and unit scale.

Rest pose: pelvis pivot at pelvis_height above the floor; chain Pelvis.spine -> Torso, Torso.neck -> Head, Torso.shoulder_l/r -> UpperArm_L/R, UpperArm.elbow -> LowerArm, Pelvis.hip_l/r -> Thigh_L/R, Thigh.knee -> Shin. Shin.sole lies on the floor plane.
LowerArm hand socket = palm surface centre; palms face the body midline in rest pose (left palm normal +Y, right palm normal -Y) so arms raised forward hold the ball between the palms.
Head eyes socket = point between the eyes (first-person camera).
Runtime-overridden slots: Team (Color), TaG (Emissive/EmissiveStrength), Glow (Emissive/EmissiveStrength), Window (EmissiveStrength; default 0 = lights off).
M_TaGBase EmissiveColor = Emissive * EmissiveStrength * VertexColor.R. Only window quads carry vertex colours (R 0.15..1.0, per-window variation); every other mesh reads 1.0.
Rim: torus with tube centre-line radius RimRadius (22.5) and tube radius RimTube (1.0), exactly the torus TaGBallSim collides against; inner edge radius is therefore 21.5.
Court/city meshes are authored in court coordinates: spawn them at the identity transform.
Collision: SM_Rooftop has one simple box (x -600..1700, y -1300..1300, z -100..0); SM_Hoop has simple boxes for the pole and padding only; all other meshes have no simple collision.
